title: A run with w:rtl reads szCs/bCs/iCs from the whole chain, never the base w:sz/w:b; an rtl paragraph mark sizes the empty line by szCs
source: prod corpus 20261021 samples 007/023 Word PDFs: Heading1 b + sz 32 with an rtl-only run -> 11pt regular on one line (docDefaults szCs 22), pitch 13.5; mark sz 36 + rtl under BodyText szCs 24 -> empty line 20.5 = 12 x 1.149 x 1.5

cases.note: twins nobody defines: docDefaults szCs 22, regular (Run.effective since the body resolver landed)
rtl mark: the chain szCs (BodyText 24), not its own w:sz 36
empty rtl line = chain szCs 12pt x the face factor x 1.5 (Calibri here: 21.96; the sample face gave 12 x 1.149 x 1.5 = 20.5)
